releases.name: Grok-1

announcement.title: Announcing Grok
announcement.quote: We are offering a limited number of users in the United States to try out our Grok prototype and provide valuable feedback that will help us improve its capabilities before a wider release.

sources.title: Open Release of Grok-1
sources.quote: We are releasing the base model weights and network architecture of Grok-1, our large language model.
sources.note: Mar 17, 2024: the raw 314B-parameter base model checkpoint (pre-training concluded Oct 2023) was separately released as open weights under Apache 2.0 — the only Grok generation to get an open-weights release.

source.title: Announcing Grok
source.quote: Grok-1, a state-of-the-art language model that is significantly more powerful, achieving 63.2% on the HumanEval coding task and 73% on MMLU.

releases.notes: xAI's original Nov 3, 2023 post offered Grok-1 as an early-access beta gated by a US-only waitlist ('a limited number of users'); it is recorded as the release date/source per project convention since it is the first public availability with a source. The model's raw base weights were separately open-sourced on Mar 17, 2024 (see sources[]). GPQA and MMMU are not applicable (both postdate this release).

releases.name: Grok-1.5

announcement.quote: Introducing Grok-1.5, our latest model capable of long context understanding and advanced reasoning. Grok-1.5 will be available to our early testers and existing Grok users on the 𝕏 platform in the coming days.

releases.name: Grok-2

announcement.title: Grok-2 Beta Release
announcement.quote: We are excited to release an early preview of Grok-2, a significant step forward from our previous model Grok-1.5, featuring frontier capabilities in chat, coding, and reasoning.

releases.notes: Launched Aug 13, 2024 as a beta on 𝕏 (as 'sus-column-r' on the LMArena leaderboard before the name reveal); the enterprise API followed later that month. Benchmark table columns confirmed by position: Grok-1.5, Grok-2 mini, Grok-2 (used here), GPT-4 Turbo, Claude 3 Opus, Gemini Pro 1.5, Llama 3 405B, GPT-4o, Claude 3.5 Sonnet.

releases.name: Grok 4.1

announcement.title: Grok 4.1
announcement.quote: Grok 4.1 is now available to all users on grok.com, 𝕏, and the iOS and Android apps.

releases.notes: A personality/alignment-focused update to Grok 4 (creative writing, emotional intelligence, reduced hallucination rate), not a new pretraining/reasoning generation. Its own launch post reports only LMArena Elo, EQ-Bench3 and FActScore/hallucination-rate figures, none of which are in the tracked benchmark basket, so no scores are recorded for this release.

releases.name: Grok 5

source.title: Elon Musk's xAI Delays Grok 5 Release to Next Year
source.quote: XAI plans to release its next-generation Grok 5 artificial intelligence model in the first three months of next year, CEO Elon Musk said on Friday.
source.note: Article body is paywalled; quote is taken from the page's own meta description / teaser text, which is present in the fetched HTML regardless of subscription status.

announcement.title: Elon Musk's xAI Delays Grok 5 Release to Next Year
announcement.quote: XAI plans to release its next-generation Grok 5 artificial intelligence model in the first three months of next year, CEO Elon Musk said on Friday.
announcement.note: Article body is paywalled; quote is taken from the page's own meta description / teaser text, which is present in the fetched HTML regardless of subscription status.

releases.notes: Reported by The Information (Theo Wayt, Nov 14, 2025): in an interview with investor Ron Baron, Musk said Grok 5 would ship 'in Q1' 2026 (6 trillion parameters, native video understanding), later than his earlier end-of-2025 target. That Q1 2026 window has since passed without a release; by mid-2026 xAI shipped intermediate models (Grok 4.5, Grok 4.6) instead, and public reporting as of Aug 2026 places Grok 5 training on the newer 'Colossus 2' cluster with no firm date — xAI has not published a revised official date, so expected_window above reflects only the original Nov 2025 statement and is now stale.

releases.name: Grok 4.5

announcement.title: Introducing Grok 4.5
announcement.quote: Today, we're launching Grok 4.5, SpaceXAI's smartest model built to excel at coding, agentic tasks, and knowledge work.

source.title: Introducing Grok 4.5
source.quote: SWE Bench Pro resolve rate: Fable (max) 80.4%, Opus 4.8 (max) 69.2%, Grok 4.5 64.7%, Opus 4.7 (max) 64.3%, GLM 5.2 62.1%, GPT 5.5 (xhigh) 58.6%.

releases.notes: xAI's parent company is now named SpaceXAI following SpaceX's Feb 2026 acquisition of xAI. Launch benchmarks focus on DeepSWE, SWE Marathon, Terminal-Bench 2.1 and SWE-bench Pro; only SWE-bench Pro maps to a tracked (non-index) benchmark in this dataset. Terminal-Bench 2.1 is a point release of the Terminal-Bench 2.0 generation but is not recorded here since the basket's preferred_config specifies version 2.0 only.

releases.name: Grok 4.6

announcement.title: Introducing Grok 4.6
announcement.quote: Today we are releasing Grok 4.6. Grok 4.6 builds on Grok 4.5 with a particular focus on long-running agents and more ambitious interactive and visual work.

releases.notes: Launch benchmarks (AA Intelligence Index, GDPVal-AA, CursorBench v3.2, DeepSWE v1.1, FrontierCode v1.1, APEX-Agents/APEX-SWE, Terminal-Bench v3.0, AA-Briefcase, Harvey LAB) are all third-party/aggregator evals not in this dataset's tracked benchmark basket (Terminal-Bench v3.0 is a newer, different-generation benchmark from the tracked 'Terminal-Bench 2.0'), so no scores are recorded for this release.
